_comment: Hand-maintained inputs of scripts/characterization_report.py. Verdicts are NOT here: they come from the 'Current reading' digest of spec/gap-to-submission.md. Evidence entries name an experiment (resolved to its live, non-superseded records) or one record_id (which must be live). Every number below is copied from the cited record's Claim.

1.target: UART, SPI modes 0-3, I2C Standard+Fast as firmware
1.measured: Firmware passes the independent reference models at RTL and gate level; constrained-random suite passes (UART RX outside it)
1.conditions: RTL / zero-delay gate level, 50 MHz clock

3.measured: Formal property proved within the harness model, single engine; serial-load shift-in not modelled

4.measured: Closes at 20 ns on 3 of the 6 declared corners (LibreLane); klt leg (netlist estimate, pre-CTS): setup closes, hold fails at the 3 macro corners; see the Fmax table

5.measured: Top instantiates the full pin budget; runtime uio direction rests on Proposed DR 0012

6.target: 256x16 program memory, serial or boot-ROM load
6.measured: Load, CRC integrity and boot paths pass on the SRAM-macro-backed memory; no silicon clock demonstrated

7.measured: See the area table: macro-backed design is 58.55 % of the 2x2 core on LibreLane; budget row stays unmet per the tracker (DR 0005 unratified, klt P&R leg blocked)

8.measured: SDF-annotated post-route regression passes at 3 corners; SRAM timing zero-delay and some gate-level images stale

9.measured: Licence set, template wired, gds workflow jobs green on the harness stub; final-design sign-off run still to come

10.measured: Cycles only, no baud measured; TX at 434 cycles/bit unmeasured

11.measured: All four modes at the f_clk/4 ceiling as a cycle ratio; pad edge rates uncharacterized

12.target: I2C Standard and Fast-mode minimum timings
12.measured: Minimums met in cycles on a logical pad model; stale gate-level/SDF records for the Fast-mode images
12.conditions: RTL, cycle counts, zero-delay pad model

13.target: A protocol outside rows 1-2 as firmware
13.measured: WS2812 and PS/2 pass their models at RTL and gate level; row not ratified

14.measured: (a), (b), reselect pass zero-delay; release-offset sweep passes under SDF at 3 corners; pads not covered; row not ratified

klt_timing.status: macro-backed netlist-estimate result at a post-v0.8.0 klt (throwaway environment, not the layout/toolchain.json pin): setup at 20 ns closes at the 3 macro-characterized corners (worst +2.867 ns), hold fails at all 3 (worst -0.2266 ns, 23 violating endpoints each; no placement, CTS or hold repair), so 50 MHz is not shown to close on the klt flow; the pinned klt 0.8.0 still cannot declare the macro

area.item: Placed cells + SRAM macro, share of 2x2 core
Top-level synthesized cell area (2,526 instances, sequential 12,933.0432 um^2)

power.reason: No dynamic-power estimate exists in either flow. `klt sta` can report power from a routed netlist, but no routed klt netlist exists (the klt leg stops at a netlist estimate); the LibreLane runs behind the committed GDS do not commit a power report. No power spec row exists, so no budget is graded.

findings: Row 7: the LibreLane flow places the macro-backed design inside the 2x2 core (58.55 %), yet the tracker keeps the row unmet because DR 0005 (SRAM macro) is unratified and the klt P&R leg has no number; the report follows the tracker and does not pick the LibreLane number as the answer.

Row 4: LibreLane reports 3 of the 6 declared corners as closing with 0 setup/hold violations; the klt netlist estimate closes setup but fails hold at the same 3 corners (pre-CTS, no hold repair). The flows differ on hold; this is a finding to record, not a number to pick from.
